children: Ezra Beyman Reports 17.9% Group Stake in Reliance Global Group

Ezra Beyman, Reliance Global Group's chairman and CEO, and two company officers disclosed a combined 17.9% stake in the company. On November 20, 2026, the three investors bought 197,905 shares from GNK Holdings for $514,553, or $2.60 per share. The purchase formed part of an agreement that led GNK to withdraw its demands for a special shareholder meeting and access to company records.

The investors bought the shares for investment purposes, while GNK agreed to withdraw its shareholder demands when the deal closed. GNK also agreed to an 18-month standstill: without the company's written consent, it will not buy more shares, seek board representation, solicit votes, or make similar shareholder demands.

Beyman and the other investors plan to review their investment over time and reserve the option to buy or sell shares or receive more shares as compensation for their work at the company. As company officers, they may also take part in management and board discussions about matters that could affect the company's direction.

Ezra Beyman serves as chairman and chief executive officer of Reliance Global Group. He is a U.S. citizen and filed this report jointly with his son, Mordechai Menachem Beyman, and company Chief Operating Officer Judah Korman. Reliance Global Group operates insurance businesses and technology businesses, including GPU cloud computing and AI infrastructure.
